SELECT 
  tenant_id, operation_key, proposal_hash, state, attempt_id, result,
  result IS NOT NULL AS result_present, error,
  created_at, updated_at, result_storage_version,
    CASE WHEN octet_length(result_storage_payload::text) <= 1398616
      THEN result_storage_payload ELSE NULL END AS result_storage_payload,
    (result_storage_payload IS NOT NULL AND
      octet_length(result_storage_payload::text) > 1398616)
      AS result_storage_overflow
     FROM operational_effect_journal
    WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND operation_key = $2
    FOR UPDATE

WITH operational_effect_journal AS (
      SELECT (jsonb_populate_record(NULL::c100_j225_active.operational_effect_journal,
        to_jsonb(j) || jsonb_build_object('result_storage_payload', $3::jsonb))).*
      FROM c100_j225_active.operational_effect_journal j
      WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND operation_key=$2
    )
